title: Latent Action Policies from Suboptimal Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.24482v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent Action Models (LAMs) learn control representations from action-free video, but existing pipelines typically train latent policies with behavioral cloning, without an explicit policy improvement objective. Although offline RL offers a natural approach to policy improvement, standard methods do not transfer directly to learned latent action spaces. We find that the structure of learned latent actions makes naive offline RL unreliable: directly maximizing value over latent actions or fitting a unimodal policy can produce latent actions that cannot be realized by physical execution, while the latent representation can merge physical controls that receive different rewards. To understand when latent-space optimization remains valid, we derive conditions under which policy improvement transfers to decoded execution and under which latent and physical optima align. translated_title: 从次优数据中学习潜在动作策略
translated_abstract: 潜在动作模型能够从无动作标注的视频中学习控制表示，但现有的流程通常采用行为克隆来训练潜在策略，缺乏显式的策略改进目标。尽管离线强化学习为策略改进提供了自然的途径，但标准方法无法直接迁移到学习得到的潜在动作空间。我们发现，学习到的潜在动作的结构使得朴素的离线强化学习不可靠：直接在潜在动作上最大化价值或拟合单峰策略，可能产生无法通过物理执行实现的潜在动作，同时潜在表示可能将获得不同奖励的物理控制合并在一起。为了理解潜在空间优化在何时仍然有效，我们推导了策略改进能够迁移到解码执行的条件，以及潜在最优与物理最优对齐的条件。基于这些见解，我们提出了LAPIS，用于目标条件下的潜在动作策略学习。
tldr: 该论文提出了LAPIS方法，通过推导潜在动作空间中策略改进有效迁移与最优对齐的条件，解决了从次优数据训练潜在动作策略时离线强化学习不可靠的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LAPIS, which derives conditions for valid policy improvement transfer in latent action spaces to address the unreliability of offline RL when training latent action policies from suboptimal data.
